name: Find Animal Bones
desc:
BRING EXTINCT ANIMALS BACK TO LIFE!

Buy pumpjacks and dig deep underground for rare discoveries  
Collect junk and turn it into ducats for better equipment  
Find missing bones and complete massive animal skeletons  
Revive each animal and add it to your pet collection  

Discover rare animals, complete your collection, and revive them ALL!

llm.loop: buy pumpjacks to dig -> collect junk into ducats -> find bones -> complete skeletons -> revive animals as pets
llm.objectives: complete every extinct animal skeleton and revive them
llm.progression: better drill equipment tiers, animal collection
llm.instructions: buy pumpjacks, dig deep, collect junk, assemble skeletons, revive animals
unique: fossil-assembly collection loop with revive-to-pet payoff
llm.thumbnails: cartoon skeleton in sand dug by a character, assembled dinosaur skeleton
llm.complexity_notes: desert dig area, skeleton models, upgrade chain
